cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "r must not be null"
cases.description: Calling removeRecord with a null argument should immediately throw an IllegalArgumentException before any lock is acquired.

input.value: Record of type Type.SOA (any name, any data)

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "Cannot remove SOA record"
cases.description: Even if the record exists in the zone, attempting to remove an SOA record is prohibited and must raise an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: No exception; method returns normally without modifying the zone
cases.description: When the zone does not contain any RRset matching the record's name and type, findRRsetWithoutLock returns null and the method exits silently.

input.value: Record of type Type.NS that is the only NS in its RRset (rrset.size() == 1, sigSize() == 0)

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "Cannot remove all NS"
cases.description: If the RRset for NS records contains exactly one record, removing it would leave the zone without any NS records; the method must reject this with an IllegalArgumentException.

input.value: Record of type Type.A that belongs to an RRset where (size + sigSize) > 1 (e.g., 2 A records, no signatures)

cases.expected: rrset.deleteRR(r) is invoked; the RRset remains in the zone with one fewer record
cases.description: When the RRset contains more than one record (or signatures), the method should delete only the supplied record via RRset.deleteRR and keep the RRset intact.

input.value: Record of type Type.A that belongs to an RRset where (size + sigSize) == 1 (e.g., a single A record, no signatures)

cases.expected: removeRRsetWithoutLock(name, Type.A) is invoked; the RRset is removed from the zone
cases.description: If the RRset would become empty after removing the record, the method should remove the entire RRset (and possibly the name) by calling removeRRsetWithoutLock.

input.value: Record of type Type.NS with name "example.com.", belonging to an RRset that contains two NS records and no signatures (rrset.size() == 2, rrset.sigSize() == 0)

cases.expected: rrset.deleteRR(r) is invoked; the RRset remains in the zone with one NS record left
cases.description: When an NS RRset contains more than one NS record, removing one of them should delete only that record via RRset.deleteRR and must not raise an exception.

input.value: Record of type Type.NS with name "example.org.", belonging to an RRset that has exactly one NS record and one RRSIG signature (rrset.size() == 1, rrset.sigSize() == 1)

cases.expected: rrset.deleteRR(r) is invoked; the NS RRset still exists because total (size+sigSize) == 2 > 1
cases.description: Even if the NS RRset has only one NS record, the presence of a signature makes the total count > 1, so removal of the NS record is allowed and should be performed via deleteRR rather than throwing an exception.

input.value: Record of type Type.RRSIG (a DNSSEC signature) for name "secure.example.", belonging to an RRset that contains one A record and one RRSIG (rrset.size() == 1, rrset.sigSize() == 1)

cases.expected: rrset.deleteRR(r) is invoked; the RRset remains with the A record only
cases.description: Removing a signature (RRSIG) from an RRset that also contains a data record should trigger deleteRR because the combined count is > 1, leaving the data record intact.

input.value: Record of type Type.A with name "missing.example.", which is not present in the RRset returned by findRRsetWithoutLock (the RRset contains a different A record for the same name)

cases.expected: rrset.deleteRR(r) is invoked; if the record is not present, RRset.deleteRR silently does nothing and no exception is thrown
cases.description: When the RRset exists but does not actually contain the supplied record, removeRecord should still call deleteRR; the operation must be a no‑op without throwing an exception.

input.value: Record of type Type.A with name "lonely.example.", belonging to an RRset where (size + sigSize) == 1 (single A record, no signatures)

cases.expected: removeRRsetWithoutLock(name, Type.A) is invoked; subsequent findExactMatch("lonely.example.", Type.A) returns null, indicating the name entry has been removed from the zone
cases.description: When removing the only record of a name (and it is not an NS set), the method must delete the whole RRset and clean up the name from the zone's internal structures.

input.value: Record whose getName() returns null (any type other than SOA)

cases.expected: NullPointerException (thrown when findRRsetWithoutLock is invoked with a null name)
cases.description: If a Record supplies a null Name, the method proceeds to the lock block and eventually calls findRRsetWithoutLock(null, rtype). The underlying implementation is expected to throw a NullPointerException, which propagates out of removeRecord.

input.value: Record of type Type.NS that is the only NS in its RRset (rrset.size() == 1) but the RRset also contains at least one RRSIG (rrset.sigSize() > 0)

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message "Cannot remove all NS"
cases.description: The method only checks rrset.size() == 1 for NS removal, ignoring signatures. Therefore even when a signature exists, attempting to remove the sole NS record triggers the IllegalArgumentException.
